notes:
- **Select, move and rotate in the Texture Studio**: a new Select tool (S) - drag to select part of a texture, drag the selection to move it, and use Rotate to turn it 90° or flip it. With nothing selected, Rotate turns or flips the whole texture. Ctrl+A selects everything, Delete clears the selection, Esc lets go.
- **Pencil size from a list**: pick 1 to 16 px from the size list next to the tools instead of typing it. The outline under the mouse now shows exactly how big the pencil is (a 5 px pencil shows a 5 × 5 square), and sizes above 8 px really paint that big.
- **Put picture**: put any PNG or JPG on a texture with the new Put picture button, by dropping it on the canvas or with Ctrl+V. It is resized to the texture, cleaned up into pixel art and placed on the face or part you are painting. You can also attach a picture in the chat and say "put this picture on my texture".
- **Chest models stay blocks**: a chest's 3D model texture now has its own "Block models" section in the Texture Studio and is made from the block's own painted sides, so it can no longer be painted like a mob. Repainting the block updates the chest model too.
- **GeckoLib for animated blocks**: chests and other animated blocks are connected to the code with GeckoLib, the same way mobs are.
- **Full build**: a new Full build button next to the chat lets the Assistant paint every missing texture, make the 3D models and animations, and connect them to the code. It asks for the detail level, the texture size and whether a block's sides are the same or different first.
- **Sizes that fit each kind of texture**: the Texture Studio offers only the sizes a texture can use - 16×16 to 256×256 for items and blocks, 256×256 for GUIs, 64×64 and up for mobs. You can also set the pencil or texture size from the chat ("pencil size 4", "make the texture 64x64").
